name: shopify
description: Manage Shopify store data via the shopify-mcp server (geli2001/shopify-mcp) — 31 tools for products, customers, orders, metafields, inventory, tags, and draft orders through the Admin GraphQL API. Replaces the old @shopify/dev-mcp documentation-only skill.

interface.shortDescription: Full Shopify store management via MCP — products, customers, orders, inventory, and metafields.
interface.longDescription: The Shopify skill wraps shopify-mcp by geli2001, which provides 31 tools for direct Shopify store management through the Admin GraphQL API. Manage products (CRUD + variants + options), customers (CRUD + merge + addresses), orders (smart lookup, cancel, close/open, mark as paid, fulfill, refund, draft orders), metafields (get/set/delete on any resource), inventory (set absolute quantities at locations), and tags (add/remove on any resource). All list queries support cursor-based pagination, sorting, and Shopify query syntax filtering. Requires a Shopify custom app with Admin API scopes and either OAuth client credentials or a legacy access token.
defaultPrompt: Use the Shopify skill for any store management task — products, customers, orders, inventory, metafields, and tags.
Confirm before destructive operations: delete-product, delete-customer, order-cancel, and refund-create are irreversible.
Use get-product-by-id before manage-product-options or manage-product-variants to get the product GID.
Check get-metafields before set-metafields to avoid overwriting values you want to keep.
